main.OID: skip: constant placeholder (-1 on every row), not an identifier
main.NAME: chart-depots, chart-lines, chart-shape, kpi:largest, insight:largest, insight:line_lead, insight:expansion — the line grouping is parsed from the word קו in the name
main.TYPE: skip: constant (רכבת קלה on every row)
main.DUNAM: chart-depots, chart-status, chart-lines, chart-bands, chart-shape, kpi:area, kpi:ex_share, kpi:largest, insight:pipeline, insight:operational, insight:largest
main.STATUS: chart-status, chart-depots, chart-lines, chart-bands, kpi:ex_share, insight:pipeline, insight:operational, insight:expansion
main.SHAPE_Leng: chart-shape — fallback perimeter when Shape_Length is blank
main.Shape_Length: chart-shape, chart-depots — perimeter and the compactness index
main.Shape_Area: chart-depots — fallback area (m², /1000 = dunam) when DUNAM is blank
